messages:
alex: quick ping — PR #20488 (feat/async-cache) is blocked by stage CI. Failing only the ui/snapshots job, one assertion: nina: :eyes: can you paste the failing assertion/log? i can take a quick look in a bit alex: here — from buildkite: ``` ui/snap/test-cache-flows › renders cached list snapshot ● Snapshot mismatch: expected 312ms to render, got 520ms - Expected:
...count: 12...
+ Received:
...count: 12...
at toMatchSnapshot (snapshots/__tests__/list.snap:12:5) ``` ci-bot: buildkite/build-3024: stage/ui-snapshots failed (flaky-targeted-shard=13). Re-run link: https://buildkite.com/redwood/3024/runs/67 sam: that looks like timing noise (render took longer). we've been seeing a couple intermittent UI snaps on staging this week — likely infra CPU contention. i'd try a targeted rerun first. command: `./scripts/ci/target-rerun --job ui/snapshots --shard 13` alex: ran the targeted rerun (3x) — results: 1 pass, 2 failures (same assertion). can't reproduce locally on my laptop. nina: hmm. can you run the test against the test harness with `DEBUG_RENDER=1` and paste the timing logs? maybe a flaky timer or animation. also share the env: node version + chrome headless version. alex: env: node 20.14, chrome-headless 117. logs: ```RENDER_START 0ms COMPONENT_MOUNT 120ms DATA_FETCHED 180ms RENDER_COMPLETE 520ms ``` qa-team: we've seen this crop up when a single background job spikes IO on the shard. workaround historically was adding a small timeout margin in the snapshot (or serializing test steps). but prefer to avoid snapshot updates unless the UI really changed. sam: agree — avoid blind snapshot updates. options: 1) increase test timeout/de-flake with a small margin, 2) add a deterministic wait for the spinner to disappear, 3) skip flaky test on that infra label and file a flaky test ticket. nina: i can try a quick local repro in docker to replicate staging CPU characteristics. if i can't repro i'll put up a tiny PR with a defensive `await waitFor(() => expect(renderTime).toBeLessThan(700))` and mark it as fixup for the flaky timing. alex: sounds good. if nina can't repro, can someone approve a short-lived skip on stage so we can unstick the merge window? we're blocked from merging a few small fixes behind this PR. cc @sam sam: i'm fine with a targeted temporary skip for stage if we open an issue with the triage notes + link to the rerun logs. please include the `buildkite` run id and tag it flaky/investigation. nina: taking it — i'll try docker repro now and report back in this thread. thanks :thumbsup: alex: thanks all — appreciate the quick eyes.
